text:
Mina: Heads up — we're planning a small proto change to the billing ingest schema tomorrow that drops the 'route_tag_v2' field in favor of a compact routing_id. This will reduce payload size but could change attribution for a subset of sessions. :eyes:

Kai: Is this the rename we discussed last week? Any plan to keep a compat path?

Mina: Yes. The service will emit both fields for 48h behind a FF (metering.proto.v2_enabled). Then after canary we flip and remove route_tag_v2 in consumer mapper.

Oliver: Concern: our invoice previews use route_tag_v2 in the UI join. If the mapper switches early we'll see ghost deltas until preview windows finish. Need graceful fallback in console.

Ashley: Suggestion: add a reconciliation metric that counts events where routing_id != legacy_route_tag. We can alert on >0.5% divergence in canary.

Dex: I'll add a streaming counter in the enrichment service. Proposed metric: `billing.routing_mismatch.count` with tags {env, canary_percent}.

Mina: Perfect. Also adding a short SQL we can run for backfill checks:```sql
SELECT routing_id, legacy_route_tag, count(*) as cnt
FROM metering.events
WHERE ts >= :start AND ts < :end
GROUP BY routing_id, legacy_route_tag
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

Kai: What about rollbacks? If we see mismatch spike, what should happen? Auto rollback or manual?

Oliver: Manual rollback to be safe. Auto rollback could be noisy for small attribution diffs. We'll orchestrate a pause + hotfix path.

Mina: Can we do a 5% canary in prod first, watch metrics for 2h, then 25% for 6h, then 100%?

Ashley: That sounds reasonable. Add the invoice-preview card to the canary cohort so early billing users can validate.

Dex: I'll hook up an A/B trace that surfaces example tenant ids where mismatch occurred so SRE/product can triage.

billing-bot: Deploy scheduled: metering-enrichment v3 -> canary 2026-03-22T02:00Z. Monitoring: billing.routing_mismatch.count, invoice_preview.delta_pct, ingest.latency.p50

Mina: One more: console should show whether preview used legacy or routing_id. Small UX patch to mark the active mapping in the preview header. Ashley can you file that?

Ashley: Filing now -> PROD-6132 "invoice preview: show routing source (legacy|routing_id)". I'll link the thread. :memo:

Kai: Any DB migration? We need to keep mapping table for 7 days to support late-arrival sessions.

Mina: No schema migration, just a short-lived mapping in Redis keyed by event_id. TTL 7d. Consumers read routing_id then fallback to legacy_route_tag if missing. After 7d we remove fallback.

Oliver: Please add a dashboard panel with a 7d rolling window showing preview diffs and invoice delta estimation. That will help finance and CS watch for surprises.

Dex: Will add panels: `preview_diff_rate`, `invoice_estimated_delta_pct`, `routing_mismatch_top_tenants`. Will also enable per-tenant drilldown links.

Mina: Action items: Mina -> flip FF rollout plan, Dex -> metrics + traces, Ashley -> console UX ticket, Kai -> rollback runbook update, Oliver -> dashboard request to finance. We'll reconvene after 25% canary or on alert.

Kai: Thanks. Ping me if mismatch > 0.5% during 5% canary.

Ashley: Noted. I'll add notice to the billing Slack channel for finance/CS heads.

Mina: OK wrapping up. Target timeline: schedule deploy (billing-bot) then 5% canary, monitor 2h, escalate if needed. :shipit: 

Oliver: Quick check — any change to token accounting or tokenization layer?

Mina: No tokenization changes. This is purely routing metadata. Token counts are untouched.

Kai: Cool. Ready on my end for runbook edits.

Dex: I'll push metrics pipeline changes in a feature branch and request reviews.

billing-bot: Canary 5% live -> metering-enrichment v3 @ 2026-03-22T02:05Z (canary_id: c-8342). Notify: @Mina @Kai @Dex @Ashley

Mina: Saw it. Monitoring running.

Ashley: Finance heads notified.

Oliver: 👍 watching dashboards.

Mina: Closing thread for now, will update with final sweep post-100% rollout or rollback.
